newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed as Dow rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed as Dow rebounds.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen mixed on Wednesday on possible continued selling of blue chips, particularly tobacco stocks, although the strong rebound in the Dow overnight was expected to boost sentiment, brokers said.
Brokers said they expected continued local interest in medium and small stocks on corporate action such as stock-splits, rights issues and dividend anouncements.
A sharp fall in cigarette firm Sampoerna on Tuesday was likely to continue but the extent would be limited as it had touched its lowest price this year, one broker said.
Brokers said cement maker Indocement and noodle maker Indofood were likely to attract market attention on Indocement's expansion plans and Indofood's net profit target for 1997.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta Composite Index ended down 6.25 points, or 0.87 percent, at 713.39 points after hitting an intra-day low of 711.42 on profit-taking.
